test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

**Neither Rina or Raju** was present in the class.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Neither Rina nor Raju**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The conjunction "**nor**" is used to connect two negative statements.
 
• The correct usage in such sentences is "**Neither...nor**", not "**Neither...or**."
 
• **Option 1** ("Neither Rina not Raju") is incorrect due to the use of "not" instead
